name: billing-4
title: Usage Metering Card
description: Usage metering card with progress bars for seats, storage, API requests, and bandwidth, plus an estimated billing total for the cycle.

standards.purpose: Tell someone what they pay for, what they have used, and how to change it.
useWhen: The account has a plan, invoices, or metered usage.
doNotUseWhen: The product is free and has no account billing.

rules.check: Amounts state their currency and billing interval.
Cancelling, removing a card, or changing plan requires confirmation that names the consequence.
Never render a full card number; show brand and last four only.
Usage meters state their limit and reset date and never show fabricated usage.
